subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs gain a supported model/provider override contract, and should that contract be `payload.model`, top-level job fields, or an explicit `sessionOverride` block?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public cron schema, provider precedence, persisted session behavior, and upgrade/docs semantics; automation should not choose that contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend systemEvent payload.model
options.body: Add model/provider handling to `systemEvent` payloads with strict validation and tests proving wake-now and next-heartbeat behavior without persistent session leakage.

options.title: Add job-level override fields
options.body: Introduce a broader cron job override surface that applies across payload kinds, accepting the larger schema/docs and precedence contract.

options.title: Keep systemEvent text-only
options.body: Document isolated `agentTurn` as the supported per-job model path and keep main-session system events tied to the target session's model state.

recommendation.title: Extend systemEvent payload.model
recommendation.body: Add model/provider handling to `systemEvent` payloads with strict validation and tests proving wake-now and next-heartbeat behavior without persistent session leakage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent history on cron session routing and adjacent model/provider behavior, which makes this the best available owner for the API/product decision.
